question: Using the bigquery-public-data.open_images dataset, can you provide a count of how many distinct image URLs are categorized as 'cat' (where the image has label '/m/01yrx' with confidence=1) and how many distinct image URLs are categorized as 'other' (meaning they have no cat label '/m/01yrx' at all)?
sql:
WITH cat_images AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.image_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.open_images.labels` l
  WHERE l.label_name = '/m/01yrx' AND l.confidence = 1.0
),
other_images AS (
  SELECT i.image_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.open_images.images` i
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM `bigquery-public-data.open_images.labels` l
    WHERE l.image_id = i.image_id AND l.label_name = '/m/01yrx'
  )
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.original_url) FROM `bigquery-public-data.open_images.images` i JOIN cat_images c ON i.image_id = c.image_id) AS cat_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.original_url) FROM `bigquery-public-data.open_images.images` i JOIN other_images o ON i.image_id = o.image_id) AS other_count
